title: dq-kernel rule pack
description: Envelope of a dq-kernel rule pack. Valid for HOCON, YAML and JSON packs alike (convert HOCON to JSON to use it). Engine payloads are intentionally open: each engine defines its own vocabulary, and the required payload key for each engine is declared in dq/engine/registry.py.

catalog_type.description: How table references resolve. Default: spark.

dataframes.description: Logical dataframe name -> table name, or a structured reference.

dataset.description: Dataset identity carried on evidence and gate events.

gate.description: Which failed checks stop a pipeline (ADR-013).

fail_on.description: any (default): every failed check blocks. error: warn-level failures do not block. never: report only.

repository.description: Where engines persist metric and verification artifacts.

engine.description: Engine identifier; built-ins are declared in dq/engine/registry.py.

dataframes.description: Logical dataframes the rule validates. Default: ["default"].

url_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the webhook URL. Required by webhook, slack and teams.
